Bridge application only. Dispatches queued wx events for all its pending handlers, not OS/idle work. Forbidden during RUN, pumps or native-to-Lisp callbacks; callback errors are re-signaled at the Lisp boundary.
Bridge application only, in an active main-thread session. Pending wx event queue observation, not OS input, future timer or idle readiness.
Active bridge application only. Native main-loop state; false during standalone pumps and the cooperative application REPL.

Owned standalone handlers only. Borrowed window identities must use window/parent destruction. Generic binding teardown and pushed-handler ownership remain open.
Own event-processing flag for exposed standalone handlers and native wxWindow base identities; separate from window input state.

Canonical generalized-boolean SETF writer for exposed handlers; native dispatch/propagation semantics, no synthetic events. Weak window tracking preserves invalidation when destroy-event delivery is disabled.

wxFrame.scope: Native-backed CLOS construction, including subclass initargs/defaults and managed rollback. Title, width and height; parent is NULL, ID is wxID_ANY, remaining options use defaults. Full class and inherited API coverage remain open. Frame-only synchronous close requests now preserve veto/force semantics and native acceptance; no destruction guarantee.

wxPanel.scope: Native-backed CLOS construction, including subclass initargs/defaults and managed rollback. Parent only; remaining constructor options use defaults. Full class and inherited API coverage remain open.

wxButton.scope: Native-backed CLOS construction, including subclass initargs/defaults and managed rollback. Parent and label; ID is wxID_ANY, remaining options use defaults. Full class and inherited API coverage remain open.

wxTextCtrl.scope: Native-backed CLOS construction, including subclass initargs/defaults and managed rollback. Parent and initial value; ID is wxID_ANY, remaining options use defaults. Full class and inherited API coverage remain open.

wxStaticText.scope: Native-backed CLOS construction, including subclass initargs/defaults and managed rollback. Parent and label; ID is wxID_ANY, remaining options use defaults. Full class and inherited API coverage remain open.

wxCheckBox.scope: Native-backed CLOS construction, including subclass initargs/defaults and managed rollback. Parent, label and initial boolean value; two-state control, ID is wxID_ANY, remaining options use defaults. Full class and inherited API coverage remain open.

wxChoice.scope: Native-backed CLOS construction, including subclass initargs/defaults and managed rollback. Parent, copied strings and initial selection; wxArrayString overload, ID is wxID_ANY, remaining options use defaults. Full class and inherited API coverage remain open.

wxBoxSizer.scope: Parent-owned horizontal/vertical layout only; standalone sizers and full API remain open.

wxWindow.scope: Logical names, visibility and effective enabled state, layout, geometry and destruction are exposed; the remaining wxWindow API stays open.

wxTopLevelWindow.scope: Canonical SETF writer. Title get/set is exposed for wxFrame only; other top-level types and the remaining top-level API stay open.

wxGauge.scope: Parent-owned progress gauge: positive range, value, horizontal/vertical orientation and pulsing. Constructor options, two-step creation and full inherited API remain open. Gauge support introduced in ABI 10; current bridge ABI 20; see docs/GAUGE.md and tests/gauge.lisp.

wxAppConsole.scope: Managed bridge application only: session lifetime, native main loop, polling, queued-event status/dispatch and callback/pump guards. No constructible application wrapper, application traits, arbitrary event loops, command-line hooks or native virtual overrides. Arbitrary native event classes and persistent mutable events, pushed-handler ownership, filters, propagation, idle handlers, timers and worker dispatch remain open. Borrowed managed application handler view supports inherited binding/dispatch/state; construction and explicit deletion reject. OS session delivery and native application subclass hooks remain unverified/unbound. Query/end-session binding is available on the managed app and isolated owned handlers; synthetic app/window session emission rejects; OS delivery remains unverified.

wxApp.scope: One managed GUI application per process on its main thread. Native initialization/cleanup only; application subclass hooks, traits, top-window APIs and remaining GUI-application interfaces are unbound. The CLOS APPLICATION-HANDLER is a borrowed event-handler view only. Borrowed managed application handler view supports inherited binding/dispatch/state; construction and explicit deletion reject. OS session delivery and native application subclass hooks remain unverified/unbound. Query/end-session binding is available on the managed app and isolated owned handlers; synthetic app/window session emission rejects; OS delivery remains unverified.

wxEvtHandler.scope: Owned/borrowed handler identities and command/close-family bindings with exact IDs/ranges, safe unbinding, copied queue payloads and weak invalidation. Callback-time receiver disposal is deferred; generic roots are reaped at Lisp boundaries. Optional contextual callbacks now control Skip/propagation for supported command/close kinds. Arbitrary event types/userData, derived notify classes, pushed chains and worker dispatch remain open. See docs/EVENT-CONTEXTS.md. Registered command/notify names and synchronous ProcessEvent are now supported; native OS session delivery remains unverified. Query/end-session binding is available on the managed app and isolated owned handlers; synthetic app/window session emission rejects; OS delivery remains unverified.

wxEvent.scope: Immutable supported command/close snapshots and current-callback wxEvent base views for Skip/propagation; close veto is checked through wxCloseEvent only. Arbitrary native construction/cloning, mutable type/origin, userData and broader families remain open. See docs/CLOSE-EVENTS.md. Timestamp/command classification snapshots and current reads, bounded native LONG timestamp SETF and close-only CanVeto SETF are implemented; snapshots stay immutable. Scoped ID reads/SETF are implemented; native routing after mutation is verified separately from snapshot immutability.

wxCloseEvent.scope: Supported close/session snapshots and scoped contexts, including checked veto and logging-off metadata. Native app bindings exist; real OS session delivery is unverified. Synthetic session queue/process requires isolated owned handlers and blocks wxApp fallback. No persistent event ownership or arbitrary close types. Timestamp/command classification snapshots and current reads, bounded native LONG timestamp SETF and close-only CanVeto SETF are implemented; snapshots stay immutable.

wxNotifyEvent.scope: Registered synthetic notify types, immutable payload/family snapshots and scoped Veto/Allow. No native control-specific notify subclasses, persistent native event ownership/cloning, validated OS session delivery or userData. See docs/NOTIFY-EVENTS.md.

wxCommandEvent.scope: Built-in and registered command tags with copied string/integer payloads and scoped dispatch. Remaining native fields/mutators, arbitrary derived classes, persistent ownership/cloning and worker dispatch remain open.
